text.title: LLM Observability Stack — Worked Examples
text.summary: Sample wiring for the procedure in 04-procedure.xml: OpenTelemetry collector routing to Langfuse and Prometheus, with the Docker Compose stack template.

section.title: OpenTelemetry routing

list.item: OTEL Collector receives spans on port 4317 (gRPC) or 4318 (HTTP)
Route to Langfuse via otlp/langfuse exporter with Authorization header
Route to Prometheus via prometheus exporter on port 8889 for metrics
OpenLLMetry auto-instruments OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain calls with zero code changes

section.reference: Docker Compose for Langfuse + Prometheus + Grafana + OTEL
